platform: native Windows x86_64, developer machine (Sundetali7), debug build, CPython 3.14.5
scope: The 66 permitted public development/regression cases (eval/fixtures: evaluation v0.5 26, challenge v0.2 35, urtisto mixed 4, urtisto benign 1). Only each case's `input` is sent; labels are not read. Persistent worker output compared byte for byte with the single-shot adapter (python -I -u -X utf8 script, one process per call) on the same classifier bytes; one worker process served all 66 calls.
limits: Transport parity only: this shows the worker returns exactly what the single-shot adapter returns, not that either classification is correct.
No held-out or sealed data was used; no generalization claim.
